antiStaleAndConsistency.authorityExpectedLatest: recovery requires canonical-root-signed latest checkpoint index and tree head observed through witness gossip
antiStaleAndConsistency.availabilityAssumption: at least two of three admitted independent witnesses and authority freshness gossip are reachable and non-equivocating
antiStaleAndConsistency.latestConsistency: entries, witnessed checkpoint, and authority freshness statement must agree exactly on latest index/head
antiStaleAndConsistency.priorConsistency: challenge binds prior accepted checkpoint; recovered complete log must reproduce that head at that exact index

binds: exact ledger revision and JSON SHA256
one service identity, role, key ID, and public key
exactly three witness identities, roles, key IDs, and distinct public keys

closedEvidenceSemantics.honestUnknown: send ambiguity and PATCH application remain UNKNOWN unless validated response evidence proves a terminal classification
closedEvidenceSemantics.requestCrossBinding: exact GET or PATCH request SHA256 carried through intent, ACK, consumption, send disposition, response, and validation
closedEvidenceSemantics.runBound: mandatory first event with exact authority/transfer/contract

blockers: witness role, identity, and exact quorum defects

closedEvidence: three distinct witness identities and endpoints

authorityChallenge: prior accepted checkpoint index and head
freshOneTimePreSendAck.recoveryRequires: both original ACK and signed consumption proof
freshOneTimePreSendAck.replay: same nonce/run/sequence/event/request tuple cannot be consumed twice; old, expired, cross-run, cross-request, or post-hoc proof is rejected
sequence: verify service-signed ACK bound to challenge and log head
atomically consume ACK once at service

beforeSigning: validate full log from zero head
validate every transition and canonical payload
validate service ACK and one-time consumption proof on every INTENT
validate request hashes, previous heads, leaf hashes, and tree heads
